turns.speaker: counterpart
turns.text: Good morning. Please hand me your passport and I-20 form.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Good morning, officer. Here are my documents.

turns.speaker: counterpart
turns.text: I see you're applying for a master's in supply chain management at Ridgefield State. Why leave a steady job at a logistics company for this?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I loved my work in Busan, but to move into a global role, I need training in risk analysis that my company just doesn't offer.

turns.speaker: counterpart
turns.text: And how are you planning to fund this entire program?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm covering half of the costs with my own savings, and my parents are helping with the rest.

turns.speaker: counterpart
turns.text: With a specialized degree like this from a US school, how do I know you won't just stay and look for a job in America?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Korea's export sector is growing fast, and companies there really need people with international training. My family is here, and my career plans are here too.

turns.speaker: counterpart
turns.text: Your plan sounds solid, and your finances check out. Your visa is approved, so expect your passport back in three business days.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Thank you so much! Have a great day.
